title: Repentance
lead: Turning back to God. Hebrew uses shuv, "turn, return"; Greek uses metanoia, "a change of mind". The idea runs from Genesis (God's grief and Nineveh-like reprieves) through the prophets' calls to return (Jeremiah 3; Joel 2:12–13) to John the Baptist, Jesus and Revelation's letters to the churches. Even God is said to "relent" (Exodus 32:14), which raises its own questions.
